headword: {年功序列|ねんこうじょれつ}

definitions.explanation: A system in which employees are promoted and receive pay raises based primarily on their length of service and age, rather than on individual performance. A hallmark of traditional Japanese corporate culture.

{年功序列|ねんこうじょれつ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{成果|せいか}{主義|しゅぎ}→成果主義：18880_seikashugi⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{移行|いこう}→移行：13776_ikou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: More and more companies are shifting from a seniority-based system to a merit-based one.

examples.english: While the seniority system brings stability, there is also criticism that it lowers the motivation of younger employees.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
One of the three pillars of traditional Japanese employment, along with ⟦{終身雇用|しゅうしんこよう}→終身雇用：13852_shuushinkoyou⟧ (lifetime employment) and {企業別組合|きぎょうべつくみあい} (enterprise-based labor unions). Since the 1990s, many companies have gradually moved toward performance-based (⟦{成果|せいか}{主義|しゅぎ}→成果主義：18880_seikashugi⟧) evaluation systems, though seniority-based elements remain widespread.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {年功序列|ねんこうじょれつ}⟦{制|せい}→〜制：30791_sei⟧: seniority system
- {年功序列|ねんこうじょれつ}{型|がた}: seniority-based model
